summary: Translate social security commitments into operational rules, accountability maps and indicators. Explore the five-day course and its practical outputs.
lede: Rights-based social protection frameworks connect social security commitments to programme entitlements, administrative duties and review processes. For policy advisers, programme managers and accountability specialists, the practical work includes mapping obligations and institutional responsibilities, reviewing eligibility and appeal procedures, and tracking rights-delivery indicators. Participants also develop implementation maps and roadmaps, and consider digital case records at an operational level.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who shape social protection rules, administer entitlements or oversee how agencies account for rights in programme delivery.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with social protection programmes, social policy or public administration is recommended. No coding is required. A laptop with spreadsheet software is useful for the indicator-tracking exercise; you can complete the mapping activities without specialist software.
